verdict.rationale: Braintrust provides SDK-based evals runnable from code, explicit CI/CD integration ('Automate in CI/CD — Run evals on every pull request to catch regressions'), a full REST API, and a CLI (`bt`) for headless authentication, running evals, syncing/querying logs, and managing functions—covering the full automation lifecycle. Missing for 10: no independent third-party report of a real CI pipeline using Braintrust in production.
